answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Sworn insurance underwriter licence with insurance regulator attestation. It requires a licence the regulator renews after underwriting audits, so the karst of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The mirror is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The ripple is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
